page.overview:
Who is Ayden?

Ayden is a 15-year-old human male with brown eyes and hair. When first seen, he was carrying a damaged shield on his back that didn't look like it belonged to him, and holding a staff carved with etchings of the moon and stars at its top.

During his last minutes as a mortal avatar, as he was in a battle that was unlocking more and more of his divinity, he rapidly aged to reach adulthood, and his head started glowing as he used his powers (before the glow came from his heart), although maintaining his face visible.

He is very calm, and sees mortals as children deserving of his compassion. He is also innocent and idealistic, and seeks solutions that prevent the suffering of others.

After the main Exandrian pantheon agreed to collaborate in a plan to neutralize Aeor and their potentially dangerous technology, the Dawnfather agreed to do his part (being one of the last ones to agree), and a decade and a half before their intended mission, he was born as a mortal human boy, Ayden.
